charge_port.notes: Electrek: launches with CCS; Stellantis plans NACS starting 2026 (electrive names the 2027 Charger as the first native NACS model, so the 2026 Recon is CCS1).

supercharger_access.notes: Stellantis (March 2026): the 2026 Recon is included with the Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 adapter. Canada implied, not separately confirmed. Canada: the reports say "North America"; no source confirms Canadian cars are covered.

adapters_included.notes: Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 DC adapter, sold by Stellantis (certified LEV dealers and Mopar.com; US $230 sale price / about $250 list per InsideEVs and Electrek, announced March 2026). Canada: Mopar.ca and Stellantis dealers, CAD 386 (Auto123, model years not stated). Canada low confidence: Auto123 only says Recon is expected to benefit. Prices in these notes come from InsideEVs, Electrek and Auto123 articles not cited here; Canada is inferred from "North America".
